_about: Mover gear, bought once from the Books page and kept for good. Each piece changes one rule: what the boxes can take, how many fit in one, how often a hand slips.

gear.name: The dolly
gear.blurb: Two wheels and a lip. Every box rides as if a fifth lighter: the weight on the boxes below counts 20% less.

gear.name: Moving blankets
gear.blurb: Six quilted blankets for the sofas and wardrobes. Wrapped pieces take 40% less of the road.
gear.effect: Wrapped pieces 40% safer on the drive

gear.name: Bed racks
gear.blurb: Steel shelves in the truck bed. A box takes eight more kilos on top before anything inside gives.

gear.name: The tape gun
gear.blurb: A real one, with the handle. Boxes seal tighter and take two more pieces each.

gear.name: Grip gloves
gear.blurb: Rubber palms. A hand slips 30% less often, fragile or not.

gear.name: Marge's lucky charm
gear.blurb: A brass duck on a string. Once a job, the first piece that would have slipped doesn't.
gear.effect: First drop of every job caught
